Referral confirmedalibaba-model-studio

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / DashScope

Invite & Earn rewards the referrer with 1 credit for the first Free Trial (maximum 50 per month), 10 credits for the first purchase and 10 % of eligible subsequent payments within the specified period. 1 credit equals 1 USD in coupon value; no confirmed cash payout.

Terms & sources 2 sources

Who is eligible?

Valid Alibaba Cloud International individual account with a complete profile and valid payment method; approval by Alibaba. Enterprise accounts, employees and resellers are excluded under the terms.

Product scope & limitations

Only eligible products and linked new customers count. Subsequent purchases count for the next three billing months defined by the program. Refunds and portions not paid in cash do not count. Check specific Model Studio/DashScope product eligibility and coupon usage before making a referral; not every API invoice is automatically eligible.

Official sources

  • Alibaba Cloud Invite & Earn – Program and terms ↗
  • Official Model Studio/Token Plan page with Invite & Earn reference ↗

Assessment

The public cloud referral program is confirmed and promoted in the AI/Model Studio product context. This does not establish that all DashScope PAYG models, regions or Token Plans qualify for commission. Program figures come from officially indexed terms; without login, the direct program page returned only limited content. No third-party referral codes were used.

Referral confirmedkimi

Kimi / Moonshot AI

After a successful first subscription, both participants each receive a chance to win credits equivalent to Kimi Go membership benefits; no guaranteed fixed voucher value.

Terms & sources 1 sources

Who is eligible?

For personal Kimi users; invitation area in the account or on the promotion page.

The friend confirms attribution through a link or QR code and pays for a qualifying first subscription within 24 hours.

Product scope & limitations

Only the first successful membership per friend counts, attributed to the first referrer; renewals or upgrades provide no additional chances.

Enterprise accounts are excluded; the earlier task for registrations alone has ended.

Prizes are credits rather than a guaranteed membership duration and cannot be transferred or cashed out; current rules specify December 31, 2026 as the expiration date, with the display under My Prizes authoritative.

Official sources

  • Moon Companion Plan: Official promotion rules ↗

Assessment

The rules have applied since September 20, 2026. The program concerns Kimi memberships; it does not establish a Moonshot API affiliate program.

The similarly named website moonshot.com is not a source for Moonshot AI.

OpenAI / Codex

Offer-dependent usage benefits, such as usage credits, a limit reset or additional usage; no generally promised cash amount.

Terms & sources 3 sources

Who is eligible?

Only eligible accounts shown an invitation offer; availability depends on plan, workspace, region and promotion.

The invited user must accept the offer and complete the required action, which may involve Chat, Work or Codex.

The reward, requirements, caps and expiration date in the specific invitation dialog are authoritative.

Credits are not automatically API credits and generally cannot be cashed out, transferred or sold.

Self-referrals and multiple accounts do not qualify; Enterprise is currently excluded according to the pricing overview.

Referral confirmedxiaomi-mimo

Xiaomi MiMo

Invitee: 10 % off the first qualifying Token Plan purchase. Referrer: 10 % of the payment as API credits; certain higher subscriptions receive 20 %.

Terms & sources 2 sources

Who is eligible?

Registered users can share their personal link or code. New users must associate it within three days of registration.

The first paid Token Plan must be purchased within 30 days of attribution; API top-ups alone do not count.

Product scope & limitations

By default, a maximum of 30 paying referrals; Standard annual, Pro annual and all Max subscription durations receive 20 % without this 30-referral cap.

Credits are awarded three days after payment and remain valid for 40 days: API usage only, no Token Plan payments, cash payout or transfer.

A previous free Token Plan lasting at least one month excludes invitation benefits; refunds invalidate the reward.

Merely associating the code does not trigger any immediate reward established here.

Official sources

  • MiMo: Promotions FAQ ↗
  • MiMo: Refer friends ↗

Assessment

The current FAQ is authoritative; historical signup promotions with immediate starting credits are not carried forward.

Referral confirmedzai

Z.ai / GLM

Referrer: 10 % of the first actual payment as platform credits; invitee: 10 % off the first GLM Coding order. Every 30 valid referrals earn an additional 10 % of their combined first payments as credits.

Terms & sources 2 sources

Who is eligible?

Invitees must be new users or existing users with no previous paid membership.

The first GLM Coding purchase must be completed within 72 hours of attribution through a link or code. If multiple valid referrals exist, the last one applies.

Credit disbursement is unlocked only after three valid paying referrals; the first three are then counted together.

Product scope & limitations

No cash payout or transfer; credits can be used for subscriptions, resource packages and API usage.

The discount does not apply to renewals, upgrades or downgrades and cannot be combined with similar first-order offers; minimum Stripe payment is 0.50 USD.

Abusive accounts and multiple accounts belonging to the same person are excluded; the provider may change the rules.

Official sources

  • GLM Coding: Credit campaign rules ↗
  • GLM Coding: Subscription signup ↗

Assessment

The rules page was last dated March 15, 2026. These are platform credits, not a cash-redeemable affiliate commission.

Earlier short-term special promotions are not treated as current rules.
